faq.q: How much does AA Accident Attorneys charge?
faq.a: AA Accident Attorneys publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does AA Accident Attorneys offer a free consultation?
faq.a: AA Accident Attorneys does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does AA Accident Attorneys have offices?
faq.a: AA Accident Attorneys publishes six offices, among them Newport Beach, Los Angeles, San Diego and Fresno. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at AA Accident Attorneys?
faq.a: AA Accident Attorneys names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
